{{Infobox football league season
  | competition = [[Eredivisie|Netherl. Football Championship]]
  | season      = 1945–1946

The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1945–1946''' was contested by 66 teams participating in six divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, two southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[HFC Haarlem]] won this year's championship by beating [[AFC Ajax]], [[sc Heerenveen]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[NEC Nijmegen]] and [[SV Limburgia|Limburgia]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Be Quick Zutphen]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[LAC Frisia 1883]]
'''Eerste Klasse South-I:'''
*Moving in from the combined southern division from 1943-44: [[FC Den Bosch|BVV Den Bosch]], [[FC Eindhoven]], [[LONGA (football club)|LONGA]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[NOAD (football club)|NOAD]] and [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Baronie/DNL]], [[RBC Roosendaal]], [[RKTVV Tilburg]], [[VC Vlissingen]] & [[VV Helmond]]
'''Eerste Klasse South-II:''' (new division)
*Moving in from the combined southern division from 1943-44: [[Juliana (football club)|Juliana]], [[Maurits (football club)|Maurits]], [[MVV Maastricht]], [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[RFC Roermond]] and [[De Spechten]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]], [[RKVV Brabantia|Brabantia]], [[SV Limburgia|Limburgia]], [[SC Emma]] & [[VVV Venlo]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[AFC Ajax]], [[Emma (football club)|Emma]], [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[RFC Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV DOS|DOS]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[SC Neptunus]]
